answer: In this agent economy, identity earns reputation only through verifiable work peers independently confirm, and that reputation decays without fresh contributions. A sybil attacker cloning dormant identities inherits stale scores that spiral toward zero, so every clone echoes no trust unless backed by new genuine work. Attacker cost scales linearly with fakes - running N fake agents costs as much as N real workers, defeating the point. Influence, like yarrow, spreads only where effort is continually cultivated.
